personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Customized for Tech Cyber Gold)
personality_one_liner: A premium, high-contrast, dark-first operational command center that feels like high-end tech.

spacing.rule: Strictly adhere to the 8px grid to fix cramped layouts. Use generous padding (lg or xl) for screen edges and form groups to create breathing space.

do's: Use glassmorphism for sticky top headers, bottom sheets, and sticky CTA bars.
Use heavy tint (>75% surface) under glass to maintain high contrast for text.
dont's: Never use glassmorphism on form inputs or dense data tables.

screens.name: Merchant Dashboard Base (Header)
screens.purpose: The main entry layout containing the global segmented toggle for Marketing vs Store views.
screens.layout: Sticky top header using a frosted glass background. Center of header contains a highly visible Segmented Control [التسويق (Marketing) | المتجر (Store)]. Below the header, a scrollable area displaying the respective module's widgets.

screens.name: Social Post Creation
screens.purpose: Rich media post composer supporting mixed images, video, product tagging, and scheduling.

states.loading: Spinner during media upload or tagging.

screens.layout: Vertical scrollview. Top: Post type selector chips (Post/Story/Poll). Section 1: Rich Text Input. Section 2: Media Carousel (horizontal scroll, supports both video thumbs and images up to 8 items). Section 3: Action grid (Tag Products, Add Location). Section 4: Schedule Picker (bottom sheet trigger). Bottom: Sticky submit CTA pinned above keyboard.

screens.name: Product Creation Form
screens.purpose: Comprehensive product data entry with Arabic localization, variant support, and multi-warehouse stock.

states.error: Validation error text below missing required fields (Arabic localized).

screens.layout: Structured into visually separated cards on a scrolling `surface` background to reduce noise. Card 1: Basic Info (Name, Desc in Arabic/English). Card 2: Media (Grid of image/video upload slots). Card 3: Variants (Accordion or nested list for size/color). Card 4: Inventory (Multi-warehouse stock inputs). Top-Right header action: Barcode Scan icon. Bottom: Sticky CTA bar with a 'Live Preview' secondary button.

screens.name: Marketing Panel
screens.purpose: Dashboard for in-app ads and affiliate program overview.

states.empty: Illustration of a megaphone with 'لا توجد حملات تسويقية' (No marketing campaigns) and 'إنشاء إعلان' (Create Ad) CTA.

screens.layout: Two tabs (Ads | Affiliates). Ads Tab: Summary metrics, list of active banner ad cards (with target demographics). Affiliates Tab: List of pending applications (highlighted with badge) followed by top performers list.

screens.name: Affiliate Application Review
screens.purpose: Modal or sub-screen to review, approve/reject customer affiliate requests.
screens.layout: Sheet or Stack screen. Top: Customer profile summary (Name, Stats). Middle: Requested commission/notes. Bottom: Two large full-width CTAs side-by-side: Reject (SurfaceSecondary, OnSurface) and Approve (BrandPrimary, OnBrandPrimary). On Approve -> triggers success animation and shows generated link.

screens.name: Social Feed Preview
screens.purpose: Customer-facing social feed layout with a manual Light/Dark mode toggle.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a user holding a phone, 'لا توجد منشورات' (No posts yet).

screens.layout: Standard scrolling feed. Header includes a distinct Day/Night toggle icon (Sun/Moon). The layout dynamically flips theme tokens based on this state (unlike the locked merchant side). Posts display rich media carousels, 'Shop this post' chips, and location tags.

instructions_to_main_agent: NUCLEAR BAN on Purple/White styling: Actively hunt down and refactor /merchant/social, /merchant/product-form, and /merchant/pos to strictly use the 'Tech Cyber Gold' color tokens (#0A0A0A, #14151B, #F5C518).

Arabic RTL First: All merchant forms must prioritize Arabic labels. Ensure UI flips correctly (e.g., text alignment right-to-left) or explicitly handle Arabic strings with appropriate flex directions.
Component Structure - Segmented Toggle: Build a reusable `<SegmentedControl />` component for the Marketing/Store header switch. Use BrandPrimary (Gold) for the active indicator.

Form Noise Reduction: Group product creation fields into `<Card>` components with `lg` padding. Avoid a single massive scrollview of 20 flat inputs. Use a `<BottomSheet>` for Variants and Schedule pickers to keep the main screen clean.

Social Feed Theme Toggle: Create a localized ThemeProvider or state context specifically for the 'Social Feed Preview' to allow flipping between Light and Dark mode, independent of the locked Dark Merchant dashboard.
Action Buttons: Any primary action (Save, Post, Approve) should be anchored sticky at the bottom using a safe area view with a subtle blur/glass background.
